sentences: PMMA rods were used in 54 of the BASS-II tests.
The audit found 122 usable final oxygen readings and set aside 7 readings.
The lowest initial oxygen level was 13.6 % and the highest was 22.2 %.
Sensors confirmed a burn in 65 tests when CO2 rose by at least 0.2 %.
Test O4 had the lowest final oxygen reading with a confirmed burn at 13.6 %.
